headline: Executive order from 2000 set up a Federal Career Intern Program for hiring interns into federal government jobs.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order created or set rules for a career intern program in the federal government. Programs like this usually give people a way to start a federal career through an internship. No summary was provided, so details such as who qualifies, how long internships last, or whether interns can move into permanent jobs cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.how: The order appears to create an internship path into federal government careers.
Agencies appear to gain a program they can use to recruit and hire career interns.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 6, 2000; the title alone does not state a separate effective date.
